versions.content: Setting of TrcvLinkState in configured state change func- tion when the referenced controller is not referencing a transceiver, nor a switch or switch port group If EthIf_CtrlModeIndication is called and the controller (either Ethernet of CanXL) given by CtrlIdx is referenced by a EthIfController which neither has a EthIfEthTrcvRef or EthIfCanXLTrcvRef nor a reference to a EthIfSwitch or EthIfSwitchPortGroup configured, then for this EthIfCon- troller which has a state change function configured (see EthIfTrcvLinkState- ChgFunction) the User_TrcvLinkStateChg shall be called and TrcvLinkState shall be used according to the following mode / transceiver link state mapping: 1. if ETH_MODE_ACTIVE has been indicated, then ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_AC- TIVE shall be propagated as TrcvLinkState 2. if ETH_MODE_DOWN has been indicated, then ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_DOWN shall be propagated as TrcvLinkState
